# Risk matrix for ESGR findings

Adapted from Anthropic `legal-risk-assessment` (Apache-2.0): the 5×5 matrix and colour bands are kept; the severity anchors are rewritten for ESMA's measures. Calibrate to the firm's own risk appetite.

## Severity (impact if it materialises)
| Level | Label | ESGR anchor |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Critical | Ability to operate in the EU at stake: no valid application by 2 Nov 2026; grounds for refusal, suspension or withdrawal (Arts 8-9, 35(1)(a)); temporary ban on publishing or distributing ratings (35(1)(b)); ESMA ordering cessation of conflicting activities or ratings (25(3)); fines towards the Art 36 maximum |
| 4 | High | Likely ESMA measure, public notice or fine; systemic (many ratings or users); hits ESMA's 2027 priorities (independence, conflicts, methodology robustness) |
| 3 | Moderate | ESMA finding needing a remediation plan; one product or process; user or issuer complaints likely |
| 2 | Low | Documentation or process weakness unlikely to change outcomes |
| 1 | Negligible | Housekeeping |

ESMA's own seriousness criteria (Art 35(5)) are useful for calibration: duration and frequency, intent or negligence, responsibility, financial strength, impact on investors and users, profits gained, cooperation, previous infringements, and remedial measures.

## Likelihood
1 Remote · 2 Unlikely · 3 Possible (foreseeable trigger, e.g. the next methodology change) · 4 Likely (routine trigger, unmitigated) · 5 Almost certain (already occurring, or ESMA review imminent)

## Score = Severity × Likelihood
| Score | Level | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 1-4 | GREEN | Accept, record, monitor |
| 5-9 | YELLOW | Mitigate; owner; monthly review |
| 10-15 | ORANGE | Escalate to Head of Compliance and Legal; dated plan; weekly review |
| 16-25 | RED | Escalate to senior management and board now; consider ESMA engagement |

**Never invent fine amounts.** For scale, describe the bases: fines up to 10% of annual net turnover (consolidated for group members, Art 36(2)), and periodic penalties of 3% of average daily turnover for up to 6 months (Art 37).

## Escalate to legal counsel when
An ESMA request, investigation or inspection arrives (Arts 32-34); a breach may need notifying; scope or exemption positions are novel (Art 2(2), Art 3(1)); a third-country route must be chosen (Arts 10-12); an Art 16(2)/(3) derogation is needed; or the matter goes to the board.
